TRUST NOTE on the SessionStart hook: enabling it means every commit to
scripts/agent-reach-preflight.sh is code that runs automatically the next
time a session starts in this directory — including on a contributor's
branch you checked out to review. That script is therefore security-
relevant, and changes to it deserve the same scrutiny as a permission
grant. Do NOT swap it for the installer: an unattended install on session
boot is exactly the thing the 'ask' bucket below exists to prevent.
